findings.title: Refund cascade dispatch topology is documented and consistent
findings.evidence: PaymentService::cashBack:152 + RefundWithCounterEntryService::execute:229 both dispatch PARENT (positive qty) via DispatchableAfterCommit. Listeners idempotent via released_qty ledger + StockMovement.idempotency_key UNIQUE. EventServiceProvider:165-168 wires 2 listeners in correct order.

findings.title: Refund cascade INHERITS OrderCanceled outbox gap — no PersistRefundCreatedToOutbox listener
findings.evidence: EventServiceProvider:165-168 lists ONLY ReleaseStock + ReleaseAvailability for RefundCreated. No outbox persistence. Same pattern as OrderCanceled (lines 161-164) — neither cancellation nor refund fans out via the outbox-broadcast SSOT. Symmetric to known cancellation gap, not refund-specific drift.
findings.impact: Connected POS/admin/OSS clients listening on private-branch.{id} do NOT receive a refund broadcast event. They become aware of refund state ONLY when they re-poll order listings, or when OrderPaymentStatusChanged fires for the parent (which cashBack does NOT trigger — see RED R-1).
findings.verdict: GAP — backlog candidate (P2; not blocker since admin daily aggregates from DB query and ZReportService picks up mirror via standard query).

findings.title: Composition snapshot copy-forward respects NF525 immutability
findings.evidence: RefundWithCounterEntryService:136 reads parent's $item->composition_snapshot directly into mirror OrderItem; never mutates parent. composition_snapshot is the SSOT for line-item pricing/options at sale time; copy-forward preserves it bit-identical.

findings.title: Mirror order Order::create() does NOT spuriously fire OrderCreated event
findings.evidence: AppServiceProvider:67 attaches only SoftDeleteAuditObserver (a soft-delete audit trail observer, NOT OrderCreated dispatcher). OrderCreated::dispatch occurs only at explicit OrderService/FrontendOrderService call sites. Mirror does not self-cascade.

verdict: REFUND CASCADE ARCHITECTURE CONFIRMED with one P2 backlog (outbox parity). NF525 invariants intact. Listener idempotency intact. 29/29 tests green.
